personal.name: Arjun Pawar
personal.title: FullStack AI Engineer | SDE @Fynd
personal.bio:
Hey 👋
I'm Arjun, a passionate software engineer specializing in developing scalable and user-centric enterprise software solutions. As a founding engineer at an early-stage AI startup, I've been instrumental in developing and deploying cutting-edge AI-powered SaaS products that streamline operations and boost productivity for businesses. With expertise in React, Python FastAPI, and cloud technologies, I excel at crafting intuitive interfaces and robust backends. Currently building autonomous AI agents at Ratl.ai and working as SDE at Fynd.

current.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering

experience.description: Currently building agentic flows for an AI Agent to perform large-scale load testing across products. Simulating millions of active users to identify performance bottlenecks and ensure system scalability. Enhancing product reliability by proactively testing under real-world traffic scenarios.

Contributed as a Founding Engineer, built and scaled an AI-powered CRM from the ground up. Developed AI insights engine using RAG techniques and LangGraph for real-time analysis. Designed vector database systems (ChromaDB, Milvus) for semantic search. Created cross-platform mobile app using React Native. Developed AI Notes using Meta Llama-3.3-70B to summarize sales calls and automate tasks. Built Voice-of-Customer Analytics enabling real-time business insights.

Developed backend for a decentralized exchange platform, enhancing transaction security by 40% and reducing latency. Created a Node.js and MongoDB-based referral system, increasing user acquisition by 35%. Built a Python SDK on the Aptos blockchain, cutting token swap times by 45%.

Built responsive UI components using NextJS, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS, improving mobile engagement by 35%. Integrated PostgreSQL via Supabase, enhancing query performance by 50%. Configured Nginx for three production domains, achieving 99.95% uptime and reducing global latency by 65%.

Worked with AWS EC2, EBS, and S3 to host and develop websites. Successfully migrated non-AWS web applications to AWS infrastructure. Developed a sophisticated Content Recommendation system using AWS Personalize. Gained hands-on experience with over 50 AWS services.

projects.title: DataPilot AI
projects.description: Built an AI-powered data assistant for Fynd sellers, enabling users to ask questions in natural language and receive instant insights. Automatically generated charts and dashboards in real time based on seller data without requiring BI tool expertise. Empowered users to make data-driven decisions through conversation-like interactions. Achieved runner-up position among 200+ participants in Hacktimus 2025.

projects.title: Splunk Query Assistant
projects.description: Created a tool that translates natural language questions into Splunk queries aligned with CIM models. Enabled non-technical users to write complex queries by simply describing what they need in plain English. Used LangGraph to interpret user input and dynamically construct valid Splunk queries. Packaged and deployed the app using Docker for scalability.

projects.title: AutolyticsAI: AI-Powered Data Analytics Platform
projects.description: Developed a no-code analytics solution enabling users without technical expertise to generate meaningful insights from data. Implemented natural language processing technology that converts user questions into Pandas operations for filtering, grouping, and analyzing uploaded CSV and Excel files. Created multilingual support for all Indian regional languages. Applied fine-tuned LangGraph model to provide automated data summaries and actionable insights. Engineered a visualization system allowing users to represent data as bar charts, pie charts, and tables that can be saved to customizable dashboards.

projects.title: FRAS: Face Recognition Attendance System
projects.description: Developed a comprehensive facial recognition solution that automates attendance tracking, eliminating manual processes and enhancing administrative efficiency. Implemented OpenCV integration for real-time face detection and recognition capable of operating reliably across diverse environments. Created a machine learning model utilizing Keras with K-Nearest Neighbors classification to accurately identify individuals. Engineered a responsive web interface using Flask to provide administrators with intuitive access to attendance records. Designed the system with scalability considerations to accommodate growing user databases.
